name: External Undertaking Status Category 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external status stage code in the format of a character string with a maximum length of 4 characters. The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

AMND.name: Amendment
AMND.definition: Status is related to an undertaking amendment.

AMTC.name: Counter Undertaking Amount Status
AMTC.definition: Status is related to a counter-undertaking amount.

AMTU.name: Undertaking Amount Status
AMTU.definition: Status is related to an undertaking amount.

APPL.name: Application
APPL.definition: Status is related to an undertaking application.

BAMD.name: Beneficiary Amendment
BAMD.definition: Status is related to an undertaking amendment requested by the beneficiary.

CONF.name: Confirmation
CONF.definition: Status is related to an undertaking confirmation.

DEMD.name: Demand
DEMD.definition: Status is related to an undertaking demand.

NEXT.name: Non Extension
NEXT.definition: Status is related to an undertaking non-extension request.

TERM.name: Termination
TERM.definition: Status is related to an undertaking termination.
